of Home Trade Ltd. and its associate companies, have been frozen. The statements
of account showing credits and debits from those accounts have been obtained
from the concerned banks by issuing a notice under Section 91 of the Cr.P.C. The
details from the obtained bank account statements have been annexed with the
report of Shri Ketan Choksi, C.A.
50. There is a balance of approximately Rs. 40 Lakhs in the frozen accounts, and
instructions have been issued to the concerned banks to keep the said amount
frozen pending the decision of the court in the present matter.

deposited in a Fixed Deposit with HDFC Bank, Lower Parel, Mumbai. Directions
have been given to the concerned officials of HDFC Bank to freeze the said amount
until further orders, and the bank has informed that this amount has been frozen.

a total case property of Rs. 9,61,59,463/- has been seized.
